verdict.rationale: Raygun's Crash Reporting includes an AI-powered 'AI Resolution' chat feature that generates root-cause suggestions and fixes directly inside the product (raygun-docs-4, raygun-docs-5, raygun-docs-6), which is a genuine in-product AI-generated insight capability. However, this is scoped narrowly to crash/error diagnosis rather than broader analytics or APM insights, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of its accuracy or usefulness. Missing for 10: evidence of AI insights across other Raygun modules (APM, RUM), independent user validation of suggestion quality.
